steps.content: Your consciousness steadies. The ground solidifies underfoot...
It reveals marble floors, silent exhibition halls, and the glint of surveillance cameras... This is unmistakably the gallery. You never made it back to reality after the last simulation ended.
Searching for an anchor, you find a mirror. The reflection gazing out holds your own features.
But in the stillness, a wisp of Mania floats beside you. An almost imperceptible touch, like a weightless finger, taps your shoulder and urges you forward.
You step; it glides an inch ahead. You pause; it hovers, waiting.
It's as though... it is leading you for someone else.
Drawing a breath, you follow it deeper into the hall.
